## Checklist

- [ ] Commands use `msf6 >` or `meterpreter >` prompt prefix
- [ ] Placeholders used instead of real IPs/credentials (`<LHOST>`, `<RHOST>`, etc.)
- [ ] Inline comments explain non-obvious options
- [ ] Verified against current Metasploit Framework release
- [ ] No unauthorized use scenarios or real-world targets referenced
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
